predecessors.name: Menabe Kingdom
predecessors.text: the north-west of Madagascar 'centered on Boina Bay' (Boeny, Sofia and Betsiboka regions); 'In the extreme north of the island the Antankarana kingdom paid tribute to Boina'

successors.name: Merina Kingdom
successors.text: Boina without the port of Mahajanga, left after 1824

ledger.x: c. 1690: King Andriamandisoarivo founds the Boina kingdom on Boina Bay. 'The kingdom was founded c. 1690 by King Andriamandisoarivo.'
1840: Imerina annexes the remnant of Boina.
1840: the Boina kingdom ends with its annexation by Imerina.

wars.name: Merina conquest of Boina
wars.outcome: Boina was a tributary of Imerina 1820-1832; Mahajanga fell in 1824; the kingdom was annexed in 1840.

certainty.note: No frontier is described; the realm was a coastal Sakalava kingdom with tributaries.
